content.text: I keep seeing people tag @clanker on Farcaster, what actually happens when you do that?

Good catch. That tag kicks off the full flow. When you tag @clanker with a name, ticker, and image, it deploys an ERC 20 token, sets up Uniswap v4 liquidity, and replies with a Frame so trading can start immediately. After that, the token gets its own space on clanker.space where the community actually forms.
How do I make sure it becomes a real community?

Think of the token as a coordination tool. Use the clanker.space token space as your home base, add context and shared rituals, and bring holders into token gated chat. When people feel like they are building together, things compound naturally.
Why not just use Warpcast or clanker.world?
Warpcast is where conversation happens, clanker.world is where discovery and trading happen, and clanker.space is where holders actually gather and coordinate. Each layer plays a different role.
